versions.changelog:
Initial release of get-3d-model skill.

- Opens the 773 LABS website in the user's Brave browser to browse 3D models and 3D printed products.
- Focuses existing Brave browser and reuses an already open 773 LABS tab when possible.
- Ensures only a single destination tab is opened and confirms homepage load before reporting success.
- Does not handle ordering, payments, authentication, or personal data entry; only website browsing.
